GlobalProtect VPN plugin for NetworkManager

APT and RPM repositories for Ubuntu and Fedora — SAML/SSO GlobalProtect connections in GNOME Settings and KDE Plasma.

Install

Ubuntu

curl -fsSL https://wmp.github.io/GlobalProtect-SAML-NetworkManager/gpclient-archive-keyring.gpg \
  | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/gpclient-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null

echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/gpclient-archive-keyring.gpg] \
https://wmp.github.io/GlobalProtect-SAML-NetworkManager $(lsb_release -cs) main" \
  | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/gpclient.list

sudo apt update
sudo apt install network-manager-gpclient-gnome    # GNOME, MATE, Cinnamon, XFCE
# or
sudo apt install network-manager-gpclient-plasma   # KDE Plasma
# or, on KDE neon (Ubuntu 24.04 with Plasma 6), amd64 only
sudo apt install network-manager-gpclient-plasma-6

Then add the VPN in your desktop's network settings: Add VPN → GlobalProtect, enter the portal address, connect.

Available releases

__VERSION_ROWS_UBUNTU__
UbuntuVersion

Ubuntu architectures: amd64 and arm64.

Fedora and compatible distributions

Fedora 44 releases for x86_64 and aarch64 are available from the signed RPM repository:

sudo rpm --import https://wmp.github.io/GlobalProtect-SAML-NetworkManager/rpm/gpclient-rpm-keyring.gpg
sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/gpclient.repo <<'EOF'
[gpclient]
name=GlobalProtect NetworkManager plugin
baseurl=https://wmp.github.io/GlobalProtect-SAML-NetworkManager/rpm
enabled=1
gpgcheck=0
repo_gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://wmp.github.io/GlobalProtect-SAML-NetworkManager/rpm/gpclient-rpm-keyring.gpg
EOF
sudo dnf install network-manager-gpclient-gnome

Available releases

__VERSION_ROWS_FEDORA__
FedoraVersion

Uninstall

# the desktop packages depend on the core package and are removed with it
sudo apt remove network-manager-gpclient
sudo rm /etc/apt/sources.list.d/gpclient.list /usr/share/keyrings/gpclient-archive-keyring.gpg
sudo apt update

For Fedora, remove the installed packages with sudo dnf remove network-manager-gpclient network-manager-gpclient-gnome and remove /etc/yum.repos.d/gpclient.repo if the repository is no longer needed.
